svg.title: Smallest angles before and after the rotation, dimensions 29 and 31
svg.desc: Four zoomed angle scales, each starting at its bound. Hollow circles: the previous configurations with unrotated directions. Orange and violet triangles: the certified configurations in dimensions 29 and 31.
